about: Crosswalk from the CS numbers on the OMR Active Leases layer (which carry no operator, acreage or parish) to the executed carbon dioxide storage operating agreements. Operator names are from the agency's own listing page; resolution numbers, dates and acreages are from the executed agreement PDFs (OCR of the resolution and first pages) or the posted agreement text. Nothing here is inferred from location or date.

lease_review_report.note: Unreconciled. The executed agreements state 239,350 acres across six agreements (11 CS numbers); GIS polygons compute to about 211,300 acres across 10. Neither the count nor the acreage matches the report, which draws on the SONRIS lease database rather than the GIS layer. Do not cite either figure as the other.

CS05.hearing: Docket OMR 23-01, hearings in St. Charles and Jefferson Parishes, 2023
CS05.source: CS05A.pdf resolution and Art. 1 (OCR): 'the tract comprised of 21,079.18 acres of State water bottoms in Lake Cataouatche, located in Jefferson and St. Charles Parishes', storage interval 3,230-11,007 ft in the Waterford Oil Co. No. 1 well (SN 64758). The 6-27-23 draft instead describes WMA land in the Salvador WMA plus Lake Cataouatche water bottoms.
CS05.discrepancy: The GIS polygons extend over Salvador WMA land (about 4,700 of 6,971 ac in a 3 km test circle are SLABS/WMA surface, and only about 3,400 ac are the Lake Cataouatche claim polygon). The executed text says water bottoms only. Read Exhibit B of CS05A-C before citing which is right.
CS05.gis_note: The three CS05 polygons first appear on the GIS layer dated 2026-10 with CD_SOURCE '(New)'. The agreement itself dates from August 2023; the new flag marks the mapping, not a new agreement.
